scheme_name: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
other_conditions: The student must be regularly studying general education in a private or government college.
The parent/guardian/husband should not be an income taxpayer.
There must be no gap in the student’s continuous study after passing the board examination.
Students residing in a government‑run hostel are not eligible for the scheme.
The applicant must possess a Vaidya Bhamashah card and an Aadhaar card.
benefits_summary: Annual financial assistance of Rs. 5,000, paid as Rs. 500 per month for 10 months.
